sentences.en: He is a serious, hardworking, motivated, grown-up and open-minded person.
sentences.zh: 他是个认真、勤奋、有动力、成熟且思维开放的人。

sentences.en: Even if your goals seem out of reach, stay motivated!
sentences.zh: 即使你的目标看似遥不可及，也要保持动力！

sentences.en: I thought you said you were motivated to do that.
sentences.zh: 我以为你说你很有动力要做那件事。

senses.zh: 激发 ；<衍生词> motivation   n .动机

mnemonic: 词根记忆：motiv(e)（动机）+ate（使…）→使有动机→成为…动机
